text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten may be a race that
wraps
up the year, but it's far from the
final race for
Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather, it marks a new beginning. With
her
determination renewed, she's got a
new lease on
life.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer dear. I was thinking...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What if I became Tarumae's mentor next
year?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I can pass on all my wisdom
and
gently guide her on her way...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That way, she can carry the next
generation of
dirt racers forward. What
do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know what she wants me to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Why do you say that?
choice_data_list: I think it's still... too early.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because Hokko Tarumae isn't the one
carrying
the new generation forward.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Me? You think so?
choice_data_list: Because Acute is the successor to the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm of course talking about Smart
Falcon, the
previous champion.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure that was her intention.
Yeah, I'm sure that was her intention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm actually positive this is what she
intended.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You were even better than I ever
imagined! I still
can't believe I got
front-row tickets to a beautiful
run like
that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You must be the person I've been
waiting for all
this time...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm sure of it! I'm so glad you've
finally
arrived... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, when the two of them
embraced
back at the Kawasaki Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think that was Smart Falcon's way of
passing the
crown.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
They'll be fine. I used to think I needed
to be here
to lead everyone along, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There are people who can take over for
me now! I
can head off to Dubai with a
clear conscience!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her parting message before she left for
Dubai was
no doubt aimed at Wonder
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear to me that Smart Falcon wanted
to
entrust dirt racing's future to her, the
little racer
who proved she was a match
for her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco wanted... me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Wonder Acute is to accept her place
as the dirt
champion, then she must also
be prepared to
protect that position. If
she can do that...
choice_data_list: Before you can pass on an era, you have to build one first.
Before you can pass on an era, you have to build one first, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's when the doors will open for the
next
generation—doors that lead to a
higher level of
racing than ever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see... It's not just the younger racers
who need
my support.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Dirt racing itself needs it. Falco and the
others
who came before worked so hard
to build up the
world of dirt racing. If
the next generation of
racers are going
to take on that mantle...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then I have to do it first so I can pass it
to them!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You have to play your part too, dear! I
expect
even more gusto than usual out
of you!
choice_data_list: Yeah, Acute! Let's do that thing!
Yeah, Acute! We're doing that thing!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now give these old shoulders a
thumping like
they've never experienced
before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Just like that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thwap, thwap!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Wahooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: THWACK!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hot DOG! Now that's the ticket!
Raaaaah! Let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute is bursting with energy!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh no, not again!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'll help you get her into the paddock.

By the way, Wonder Acute...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You're looking as energetic as ever! If I
didn't
know any better, I'd think this was
your debut
race!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to learn everything I can from
you
today, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Then, when I'm a senior next year, I'm
going to
become the new star of dirt
racing!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Tarumae dear, but I'm afraid
it's not
going to be that easy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I still have a some fight left in me!
Hohoho!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute? Wh-what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen you like this before a
race! Your
eyes are practically shining...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's like all the weight's been
lifted
off my shoulders. I'm packed full
of motivation.
And you know why?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's because I've stiiiiilllll got it! I can still
run!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And not only that! I can run and run and
run and
run
andrunandrunandrunandrunandrun and
RUN!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So please, everyone out there
watching...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Keep cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is a riot today! She's so
full of
energy!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's like there's no limit to what she can
do!
You got this, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Between the storm of cheering voices
from the
crowd and the undying strength
still inside of
Acute, it's way too early
for her to pass on the
torch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute accepts Hokko Tarumae's

challenge, aiming to prolong her silver
generation
as long as she can.
